record.paper_title: Open Problems in Universal Induction & Intelligence
record.original_question: What algebraic properties and deeper structural principles characterize AIXI, and can they be distilled into an axiomatic characterization that separates essential assumptions from technical details and thereby guides proofs about the model?

evidence.quote: c) Structure of AIXI. The algebraic properties and the structure of AIXI has barely been investigated. ... It should be possible to extract all essentials from AIXI which finally should lead to an axiomatic characterization of AIXI. The benefit is as in any axiomatic approach: It would clearly exhibit the assumptions, separate the essentials from technicalities, simplify understanding and, most importantly, guide in finding proofs.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let the AIXI agent be defined as follows. Fix finite alphabets $\mathcal{A}$ (actions) and $\mathcal{O}	imes\mathcal{R}$ (observations and bounded rewards $r_t\in[0,1]$). Let $\mathcal{M}$ be the class of all lower semicomputable chronological semimeasures $
u(o_{1:n}r_{1:n}\,\|\,a_{1:n})$ over interaction histories, and let
$$\xi(o_{1:n}r_{1:n}\,\|\,a_{1:n})\;=\;\sum_{
u\in\mathcal{M}} 2^{-K(
u)}\,
u(o_{1:n}r_{1:n}\,\|\,a_{1:n})$$
be the universal Solomonoff–Bayesian mixture, where $K(
u)$ is the prefix Kolmogorov complexity of $
u$. For a fixed horizon $m$ (or appropriate discounting), the AIXI policy chooses
$$a_t^{\mathrm{AIXI}} \;\in\; \arg\max_{a_t}\sum_{o_tr_t}\cdots\max_{a_{t+m}}\sum_{o_{t+m}r_{t+m}}\Big(\sum_{k=t}^{t+m} r_k\Big)\,\xi(o_{t:t+m}r_{t:t+m}\,\|\,a_{<t+m+1}).$$

Identify the algebraic and structural properties of the AIXI value functional $V^{\mathrm{AIXI}}$ and policy operator $\pi^{\mathrm{AIXI}}$ — for example linearity/convexity in the mixture, monotonicity in rewards, invariances under reparametrization of $\mathcal{M}$ and the prior $2^{-K(\cdot)}$, compositional behaviour under products and projections of environments, and fixed-point/Bellman-type identities — and produce a finite list of axioms on a pair $(V,\pi)$ acting on environment classes such that any $(V,\pi)$ satisfying these axioms must coincide with $(V^{\mathrm{AIXI}},\pi^{\mathrm{AIXI}})$ up to an explicitly described equivalence. The axioms should isolate the essential assumptions (universality of the mixture class, rationality/expectimax optimality, and complexity-weighted prior) from technical specifics (choice of universal Turing machine, particular discounting scheme), and should be usable as a tool for streamlining proofs of properties of AIXI.
artifact.status_search_result: No published axiomatic characterization of AIXI separating essential assumptions from technical details appears in the literature. Web searches return only general references on axiomatic systems and algebraic structures, with no specific result establishing such a characterization for AIXI. The structural/algebraic study of AIXI remains largely undeveloped.
